evidence.reason: At the current tip, prepare_run still selects the SSH forwarding port with free_port() and persists it in the run record. Since free_port() releases its probe socket before launch, two prepared runs can receive the same port; the saved port is then reused by boot. No launch-time reselection or bind-collision retry is present in the supplied current code, and the current contract does not retire or supersede this ordinary correctness concern.
